main_text.p: stigia sequuntur Lutherani & Calvinistæ, idcirco renovârunt hæresin, aut Sanctos omni honore spoliant.

5 Porrò VViclefus apud Thomam VValdensem, titulo decimotertio, ne loquutus quidem hac de re arguitur: sed VViclefistæ quidam, Sartor, & Purney. Pro quibus cur substituit VViclefum Bellarminus? An quia verebatur, ne, si ipsius sententia De Sanctis canonizandis cap.128.citasset, {a}titulo decimoquarto, nempe plus coli a multis Sanctum novum recens canonizatum quam Dominum Iesum Christum, pateret cultum Dei delatum esse creaturis: nec honorem Sanctorum, sed idololatriam VViclefo displicuisse? Atqui & VViclefistæ, {b}loco citato, deferri volunt Sanctis adorationem, prout {c}adorare dicuntur qui salutant ac venerationis signum quoddam exhibent: dissentiente quidem VValdense, & affirmante, Sanctos magnifice venerandos esse, immo congruentius (ut addit) adorandos, non salutandos qualitercunque; veruntamen agnoscente nequaquam illis detrahi omnem honorem. Adeo manifestam in hisce de Eustathio, Eunomio, Vigilantio, Claudio, & VViclefo, aut no bis ex ipsorum comparatione, aut ipsis simul & no bis, iniuriam facit Bellarminus.

6 Manifestiorem in iis quæ subjungit, de Magdeburgensibus, & Calvino. {d}Magdeburgensiū enim verba generalia sunt, Omnes creaturarum adorationes damnari: ut idololatriam, in scriptis Apostolorum. unde si sequatur, idololatriæ à Magdeburgensibus dānari omnem honore Sanctis mortuis habitū: sequatur itē oportet, omne honore hominibus vivis Cent.1.lib.2. cap.4.col.297 & 299.habitum ejusdem criminis dānari. Quod quàm sit absurdè falsum, quis nō videt? quum ipsi, {e}ibidem, in Apostolorū scriptis tradi doceant, honore & {f}parentibus

page.notes: The line-end "tibus" at the foot is the continuation of the word after {f}; the exact printed form "pare-/tibus" is uncertain, so the word is shown as printed in the scan and no hyphen is added. The mark after "ipsi," reads as "e" (matching the margin note) rather than "c"; the mark after "citasset," is printed as a small "a". Left-margin notes a and e are placed at their lines. Bottom-left margin has marks "f" and the note "Ephef.6.2." Footnote-style references b, c, d, f have been placed as foot notes under the text, as the page does not print them inline beside the column. Because the marginal note texts for b, c, d, f are partly set in the margin, their placement is an approximation.
